- Orchid_MSA_redline_v3.docx (MSA with our proposed Exhibit consolidation)
- OrderForm_Q3_capacity_uplift.xlsx (capacity schedule with the proposed 2.5x uplift profile)

2) The commercial team requested a 24-month term (instead of the current 12-month) to lock the blended unit price we discussed. If that's acceptable, legal will need to confirm rollback/change of the automatic renewal clause (Section 5.2) and the termination notice window.

Ben and Priyom are looped in for redline fidelity and orderform sequencing. If your team can send a prioritized list of non-starter clauses, we can circulate a counter with tracked edits tomorrow.

Camila —

Appreciate the materials. A few quick notes from procurement/legal:
- We prefer separate exhibits per product line for internal billing reconciliation; consolidation will require an internal approval (takes ~1 week).
- The 24-month term is something leadership will support for the price, but legal flagged Section 9.4 (data retention) — they want retention windows to mirror our SOC 2 data-handling rules.
- Also, can you confirm whether the uplift in the order form is a guaranteed commit or an aspirational ramp? Our FP&A team needs clarity for forecasting.

I'll route the redline to our GC today and get back with non-starter items by EOD tomorrow. If you have a short summary document (one-pager) that maps the uplift numbers to commit vs. optional capacity, that would help accelerate signoff.

Best,

Laurie — attaching the two exhibit variants and a diff summary. See attachments: Exhibit-B-sequencing-diff.txt and OrderForm_Q3_capacity_uplift.xlsx.

Highlights:
- Variant A (consolidated): single Exhibit B with ramped monthly commitments for all product SKUs; simpler sign-off for future addenda, smaller DocuSign surface area.
- Variant B (split): Exhibit B1/B2 per SKU; mirrors Orchid's internal billing but requires per-addendum mapping for cross-product discounts.
- Commit structure: We proposed a minimum monthly committed unit (line item) plus a burst tier billed at 1.6x the committed rate. If Orchid confirms committed units, the blended price in the order form holds for the 24-month term.

Next steps requested from Orchid:
1) Confirm exhibit preference (A or B) or ask for the split-exhibit template.
2) Confirm whether the Q3 uplift numbers are committed or aspirational (we included both flavors in the spreadsheet).
3) Legal redlines on Section 5.2 (renewal) and Section 9.4 (data retention) so we can finalize.

If Orchid insists on split exhibits, we'll supply a crosswalk doc to map discounts across exhibits.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Renewal Specialist | Redwood Inference

Camila / Priyom —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Our GC reviewed and provided the following guidance:
- Exhibit preference: we will accept Variant A (consolidated Exhibit B) provided we get the crosswalk spreadsheet that maps billing lines to our internal cost centers. Procurement attached the signed request for the crosswalk and our FP&A has confirmed the committed baseline if written into the order form.
- Commit vs optional: Confirmed — Orchid will commit to the baseline monthly units in Q3 for the 24-month term. Burst capacity is optional and billed at the on-demand multiplier you proposed. Please ensure the order form includes a clear "Committed Units" line and a separate "Optional Burst" line so our systems can ingest each.
- Data retention (Section 9.4): Our GC asked for explicit maximum retention windows for logs tied to customer-owned data; Kimberly, can you insert the SOC2-Annex A reference and a 365-day maximum for customer logs?

Action items we received to us:
- You (Redwood): provide crosswalk spreadsheet + finalize the consolidated Exhibit B with the committed baseline written into the order form; include language for 24-month term with 60-day renewal opt-out.
- Us (Orchid): we will review the finalized consolidated Exhibit and complete internal signature routing; expect to return redlines on the final MSA within 3 business days.

If you can route a DocuSign packet with the consolidated Exhibit + order form (tracked edits) by EOD tomorrow, we'll prioritize signature.

Regards,
Laurie
